text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because she's always guarding the ranch for us,
but when push comes to shove, Shiori's super dependable.
choice_data_list: You could give her a run for her money.
She never lets her prey get away.
I wish she had more self-confidence.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつも牧場の警備をしてくれてるおかげか、
いざというときのシオリちゃんって
頼もしいわよね。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Don't surprise me with sudden praise.
There's no way I could guard the ranch...Ah, actually, I definitely
could scare away any suspicious lurkers eyeing up the place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なに？
　いきなり。
びっくりしたぁ。
私に牧場の警備はできないわよ……
あ、
でも
私を見た怪しい人たちが
逃げて行ったことはあるわね。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
She looks so cool when she's shooting her bow, right?
I'd love to try battling like that. Well, I'd have quite a job without fingers.
But instead, I can compensate for Shiori's lack of close combat ability.
text_block_list.orig_text:
弓を引く姿がかっこいいわよね。
私もあんな風に戦ってみたいわぁ。
まぁ、
弓は扱えないんだけどね。
その分、
シオリちゃんが苦手な接近戦は
私が補うことにするわ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Sure, maybe she isn't the strongest person ever, but she's
a kind girl who understands the feelings of others like her.
We should do more to praise her wonderful traits.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね。
確かに
体は丈夫じゃないかもしれないけど、
そういう人たちの気持ちも分かる
やさしい子だものね。
シオリちゃんのすごい所、
もっと教えてあげなきゃ。
